healthNotice.lead: If you have any of the following, please train only on the advice of a medical professional or a qualified expert:
items: Heart disease or high blood pressure
Dizziness, fainting or chest pain during exercise
A doctor has told you to limit physical activity
Any other chronic condition or ongoing treatment
healthNotice.footer: Information in this app does not replace medical advice.

injuryAdvice.train_lower: You have an upper-body injury: focus on lower-body training (legs, glutes) so your upper body can rest and recover.
injuryAdvice.train_upper: You have a lower-body injury: focus on upper-body training (chest, back, shoulders, arms) so your lower body can rest and recover.
injuryAdvice.rest: You are injured in both your upper and lower body. Please take a break from training and come back once you have recovered. If needed, ask a medical professional before you start again.

profileSetup.aIReceivesOnlyStructured: AI receives only structured data needed for plan recommendations. A Trainer can view this profile only when assigned and permitted.

energy.title: Daily energy estimate
energy.disclaimer: This is an estimate from the Mifflin-St Jeor equation times an activity factor (FAO/WHO/UNU), not an exact measurement for you. Workout calories are already part of the activity factor, so they are not added again. It will be calibrated against your weight trend over time.
energy.missing_input: Enter your date of birth, sex, height, weight and activity level to see your calorie estimate.
energy.under_age: The calorie estimate currently applies to people aged 18 and over.
energy.sex_unsupported: The equation needs Male or Female, so an automatic calorie estimate is not available.
